summary: Iteration 3 backend regression for Myra-project. Extended pytest suite from 29 → 42 cases to cover the new in-app quiz (GET /api/quiz/questions, POST /api/quiz/submit with 3 Excel-formula test vectors + 4 validation paths), the new 'chat history never deleted' contract on /api/codes/verify and /api/codes/reset, the new state_code tagging on chat_messages docs, and a real Gemini 3.1-pro round-trip exercising the Myra system prompt + 70k-token KB. 42/42 passed in ~23s.

minor.issue: Same generic 400 message is reused for both 'len != 21' and 'value out of range' — the frontend can't tell them apart from response body alone. Consider returning a structured error (field + code) for the in-app quiz UX.
Pydantic body declares `answers: List[int]`, but raw JSON like `[1, 1, ... "x"]` is rejected with FastAPI 422 (not the Hungarian 400). Consistent error envelope would be nicer.
Stale comment block in the !=200 branch is still misleading (carried over from iter 1 / 2). Cosmetic only.

/app/memory/test_credentials.md still references the obsolete 1234/5678/9012/4321 demo table from iteration 1 (the 1234/4321 entries are still valid 256-seed codes, but 5678/9012 are NOT — out of [1..4] range). Update to point at the canonical 2334 / 2222 / 1111 / 4344 test codes used in iter 3 quiz vectors.

action_items: (Optional) Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to drop the obsolete 5678/9012 demo entries and document the new quiz-vector canonical codes (1111, 2222, 4344) and what answer arrays produce them.
(Optional) Differentiate 400 messages in /api/quiz/submit between length, A/P/H scale, and C scale violations so the in-app quiz can highlight the offending question.
(Optional) Clean up the stale comment block in the !=200 branch of /api/auth/session.
(Optional) Add a unique index on (user_id, code, created_at) on quiz_submissions if analytics queries grow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 676 lines (was ~486 in iter 2). Still single-file but approaching the 700-line guideline; suggest splitting quiz_questions/quiz_submit + the QUIZ_QUESTIONS/QUIZ_SECTIONS data tables into /app/backend/quiz.py for the next iteration.
Bucketing function _bucket_from_norm correctly applies the Excel ladder (≤0.3→1, ≤0.6→2, ≤0.8→3, else 4); verified against the 3 user-supplied vectors (1111, 4344, 2222).
p_norm inversion (1 - sum/30) for DERS is correctly applied — matches the Excel `1-xp/30` formula.
Validation order in /api/quiz/submit: length → per-section range → DB lookup. Safe; can't hit a missing-code 500 unless the 256-seed is corrupted.

chat_messages now carry a `state_code` field on every NEW insert; the chat_send replay query correctly filters by (user_id, state_code) so old threads don't bleed into the new code's context. Confirmed via TestChatStateCodeField.
/api/codes/verify and /api/codes/reset no longer touch chat_messages — explicit comments in source document the new contract. Two regression tests assert message count is unchanged after each.
quiz_submissions is a new collection — no index defined yet; fine for v1.
ObjectId is correctly excluded with {'_id': 0} in all reads, including the new quiz endpoints.
Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — already correct, no changes needed.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (added quiz_submissions cleanup in regular_user / admin_user teardown)

/app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (rewrote TestCodeVerify::test_reset_... → test_reset_clears_code_but_keeps_history; added test_verify_does_not_delete_history; added TestQuiz with 9 cases; added TestChatStateCodeField with 1 real-Gemini case)
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral users + sessions injected directly into MongoDB (users, user_sessions, chat_messages, quiz_submissions) with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up in fixture teardown. Pre-existing 256 state_codes (seeded by scripts/seed_codes.py) are read-only except for the TestAdmin::test_admin_crud case which mutates code '1111' and restores the original document in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest . -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. 42 tests, ~23s. TestChat::test_chat_real_gemini_and_history and TestChatStateCodeField::test_chat_send_persists_state_code_field each make a REAL Gemini 3.1-pro call (~10s each) and both will pytest.skip with status 402 if the EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget is exhausted (per user note in this iteration). Quiz vectors covered: 1111 (all-min), 4344 (all-max), 2222 (mid). Validation paths: too-few=20, too-many=22, A-answer=7 (>5), C-answer=5 (>2). All 256 codes are still seeded and intact after the run.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All iter-3 quiz + chat-preservation contracts verified end-to-end against the public preview URL.
